with embed tab, floating window and Console/Network/Errors toolbox.
# dsh-web-preview

Preview **any local web server** inside the DeepSeek Harness GUI — reliably, even
when the GUI is re
ached through a reverse proxy from a remote browser.
## The problem it solves

The DSH web GUI is usually reached over `https` through a reverse proxy (a
hostname or public IP). A

plain `<iframe src="http://127.0.0.1:4173/">` inside
that GUI **does not work** from a remote brows

ain `<iframe src="http://127.0.0.1:4173/">` inside
that GUI **does not work** from a remote browser:

- `127.0.0.1` resolves to the *browser's* own machine, not the host running DSH;
- `http://` on an `
https` page is blocked as **mixed content**.

`dsh-web-preview` proxies a **local server on the DSH host** through the DSH
origin, so the iframe s

tays same-origin and `https` while the bytes come from a
`localhost` port on the machine DSH runs on

ays same-origin and `https` while the bytes come from a
`localhost` port on the machine DSH runs on.
## Features

- **Remote-browser-safe** — no mixed-content, no wrong-localhost, no
X-Frame-Options issues from the

DSH side.
- **Embedded tab** — a "Web Preview" tab in the conversation window (rendered
as a real R

eact slot component).
- **Floating window** — a `PREVIEW` button + draggable window, if you prefer a

side panel.
- **Diagnostic toolbox** — collapsible **Console / Network / Errors** panels
that captu

re what actually happens inside the iframe (the plugin injects a
capture script into proxied HTML an

d beacons console output, fetch/XHR
activity and runtime errors back to a host buffer you can poll).

- **Any local port** — type `localhost:5173`, `127.0.0.1:8080`, etc. The client
encodes the origin

into `/web-preview/__proxy/<origin>/<path>` and the host
forwards to it. No hardcoded port.
- **Conf

ig-driven defaults** — prefill the toolbar, pin a default upstream, and
add extra same-origin aliase
s (e.g. for an app that hardcodes `/cesium/`).

## Configuration

All keys are optional. Put them under the plugin's `config:` in the profile
patch (the loader passes
only `config:` to the plugin):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

If `defaultUpstream` is empty, the toolbar's typed URL is the only way to pick a
target — and the **

dynamic** `/web-preview/__proxy/<origin>/<path>` form works
for any localhost origin, with no config

* `/web-preview/__proxy/<origin>/<path>` form works
for any localhost origin, with no config at all.
## How it works
| Layer | What it does |
| **Client** (`client.js`) | Registers a `conversation.view` tab (React host) + a `shell.overlay` fl
oating window. Rewrites loopback URLs (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`) to same-origin `/web-preview

/__proxy/<encoded origin>/<path>`. Polls `/web-preview/__events` for diagnostics. |
| **Host** (`ind
ex.js`) | Registers proxy + diagnostic routes on the DSH `webServer`. Forwards to `http://<origin>/<
path>`, injects the capture script into HTML, buffers diagnostics. |
## Routes (all under the DSH origin)
| Route | Method | Purpose |
| `/web-preview/__proxy/<origin>/<path>` | any | Forward to `http://<origin>/<path>` (dynamic, any l

ocal port) |
| `/web-preview/<path>` | any | Forward to `defaultUpstream` (only if configured) |
| `

<alias.prefix>/<path>` | any | Forward to `alias.origin + alias.path` (per `extraAliases`) |
| `/web

-preview/__report` | POST | Browser errors (capture script) |
| `/web-preview/__console` | POST | Br

owser console output (capture script) |
| `/web-preview/__network` | POST | Browser network activity

(capture script) |
| `/web-preview/__events` | GET | Buffered diagnostics (`?since=<id>`) |
| `/web

-preview/__clear` | POST | Reset the diagnostic buffer |
| `/web-preview/__config` | GET | The resol
ved plugin config (Client reads defaults) |
## Security notes

- The host forwards only to a **local loopback** origin that the client encodes
— it never proxies a

n arbitrary remote URL. Loopback targets are validated
client-side before encoding.
- The capture sc

ript runs **inside the proxied iframe**, sandboxed by the
iframe's own `sandbox` attribute; it only

beacons to the DSH origin.
- The diagnostic buffer is in-memory and capped (2000 events).
